key_impacts: 18 districts in Odisha and 3 districts in Andhra Pradesh affected
21 deaths due to the cyclone; subsequent floods caused 23 deaths in Odisha and 1 in Andhra Pradesh
Significant flooding in Jharkhand, Bihar and Chhattisgarh
Gusts up to 185 kph recorded at Gopalpur
evidence_snippets: On 12th October 2013, Phailin Cyclone crossed the coastline south of the city of Brahmapur in Odisha
18 districts in Odisha and 3 districts in Andhra Pradesh affected; significant flooding in Jharkhand, Bihar and Chhattisgarh
Over 13 lakh people evacuated; 21 deaths due to the cyclone; subsequent floods claimed 23 in Odisha and 1 in Andhra Pradesh
